resources.string: Ask a relative to add your contacts.
This feature is not available on this phone.
A few steps, for the person setting up the app (the family). Android will ask its own questions: accept them.
To reopen the settings later: tap the time 7 times, at the top of Simple\'s home screen, then enter the family code.
Choose Simple as the home screen
This code protects the settings: the home screen does not open them without it.
All set: home screen, contacts and messages are ready.
In the list that opens, tap “Simple” then turn the switch on.
If a button does nothing, Android may have remembered a refusal. Open the app settings to allow it by hand.
The messages kept by Simple are erased.
The photos of your family are erased from Simple (the phone\'s gallery is not touched).
Who appears for calls, and their photos
Pair the display of the house
Empty the messages or photos kept by Simple
To come back here: the “Family settings” icon of the phone, or 7 taps on the time at the top of the home screen.
Simple shows the messages received after notification access is turned on (the phone\'s Messages app and WhatsApp). Older messages are not imported.
The phone\'s messaging app: %1$s. Simple does not recognise it yet: its messages will not appear.
No messaging app was found on this phone.
Certificate fingerprint (shown by the home display at start-up)
Appearance saved. It applies to the home screen.
Tap to see. A code: do not give it to anyone.
This number is not in your contacts.
Direct SMS: on (Simple reads your SMS and sends some without being the SMS app)
One line per message seen by Simple (no name, no text). Send yourself a message, then tap “Refresh”.
Nothing yet: no message has reached Simple.

resources.string: Simple is already the home screen.
Simple is not the home screen yet. The phone\'s “Home” button opens another app.
Android will show a list: choose Simple.
Nothing changed. You can try again.
Simple is now the SMS app.
Android did not make Simple the SMS app.
This version cannot become the SMS app yet. Turn on notification access to see the SMS and WhatsApp messages you receive.

Android sometimes blocks these settings for an app installed by hand. To unblock them: 1. Tap the button below. 2. Tap the three dots at the top right. 3. Tap “Allow restricted settings” (this choice sometimes appears only after a first try). 4. Come back here and try again.
This pairing link is not valid (address outside the house, missing or wrong secret, wrong fingerprint).
COMPARE this fingerprint with the one shown on the home display (command “npm run pair”). If it is different, or if you did not run this command, tap “Cancel”.
This REPLACES the current pairing: %1$s. Its fingerprint was:
Paired. The pairing code is protected.
The home display refused: this QR code was already used or is more than 2 minutes old. Run “npm run pair” again.
Cannot reach the home display. Check that the phone is on the home Wi-Fi.
Too many failed tries from this phone. Wait a minute, then run “npm run pair” again and scan the new QR code.
Unexpected answer from the home display.
Tip: on the home display, run “npm run pair” and scan the QR code with the camera.
Pairing code protected by Android\'s Keystore.
Warning: this phone has no usable Keystore, the pairing code is not encrypted.
The pairing must be redone: the key that protected the code was lost.

4 to 8 digits. Tap the eye to see what you type, and write the code down. If it is lost, you will have to erase the app\'s data in Android settings: this also deletes the messages and the pairing with the home display.
These settings are for the family only.
Nothing to do here. All is well.
For the family: open the “Family settings” icon of Simple, then choose a code.
The two codes are not the same.
The code must have 4 to 8 digits.
This code is too simple (1111, 1234…). Choose another one.
Too many tries. Try again in %1$d seconds.
The answer cannot be sent from here. To answer, go through WhatsApp. To come back here, tap the house.
The message could not be sent on WhatsApp. Tap “Open WhatsApp” to answer there.
The conversation changed. Tap “Reply” to start again.
WhatsApp is not installed on this phone.
The message will be sent on WhatsApp, not by SMS.
Your photo is on its way.
The photo could not be sent. Tap “Send” to try again, or choose another photo.
Tap the photo to enlarge it.
I am copying your old messages. Nothing is erased.
The message will be sent right away.
The message could not be sent. Ask a relative.
Who do you want to write to?

Tap “Yes” or “Allow” each time.

Your messages are not erased.

An https address on the local network, a pairing code of at least 16 characters and the certificate fingerprint (64 characters) are required.
Notification access: off. It is only used for missed calls, SMS and WhatsApp, and nothing leaves the house.
